recall.uz: Sonlarni taqqoslab, qaysi biri qancha katta yoki kichik ekanini ayirish bilan topamiz. Masalan, Uranning 27 ta, Neptunning 14 ta yoʻldoshi bor: Uranda 27 - 14 = 13 ta koʻp.
recall.ru: Сравнивая числа, находим вычитанием, какое больше или меньше и насколько. Например, у Урана 27 спутников, у Нептуна 14: у Урана на 27 - 14 = 13 больше.
recall.en: Comparing numbers, we use subtraction to find which is bigger and by how much. For example Uranus has 27 moons, Neptune 14: Uranus has 27 - 14 = 13 more.

alt.en: How many more? We find the difference

prompt.en: Look at the scale: 27 and 14 — which sign is correct?
